name: Vertex AI (Google Cloud)
billing: Requires a Cloud project with billing, the relevant API enabled, model access and regional quota. Token rates and other charges depend on your model and region.

regions.name: Your Cloud project and region
regions.note: Set the project and region names below to match the model you can use. The package’s default region is not a promise of model availability.

steps.title: Prepare your Cloud project
steps.body: Choose a Cloud project, enable billing and the relevant model API, and arrange the permissions and regional quota your application needs.

steps.title: Create local Application Default Credentials
steps.body: Install the Google Cloud CLI on your own machine, select your project, and run gcloud auth application-default login there. Follow Google’s sign-in instructions locally.

steps.title: Keep ADC local to your application
steps.body: Run the application as the user who configured ADC. Do not download, paste or upload a service-account JSON for this walkthrough. The application reads local ADC itself; this website never opens it.
